name: Generic GUI
scope: General operation of a graphical desktop interface independent of a specific application.
knowledge: A GUI is stateful: actions operate on currently visible semantic controls and change observable state.
Named destinations and ordinal results are different concepts.
A named destination should normally be addressed by its semantic label; an ordinal result is addressed by its position among results.
planning_rules: Prefer semantic operations over low-level gestures whenever the requested target is named.
Use OPEN(target=X) for a destination explicitly named X.
Use OPEN_RESULT(index=N) only when the user identifies a result by ordinal position such as first, second or third result.
